pointwise.source_version: neon-depthwise intermediate version; not final pipeline qualification

classifier.source_version: automatic-classifier-budget intermediate version; one warmup and one instrumented sample per policy

explicit_four.budgets: CpuBudgets { capacity: 8, line_workers: 4, preprocess_workers: 8, detector_threads: 8, recognizer_base_threads: 2 }

automatic.budgets: CpuBudgets { capacity: 8, line_workers: 4, preprocess_workers: 8, detector_threads: 8, recognizer_base_threads: 2 }

arena.scope: real TinyREC graph prefix, cached shape rebinding only; zero inference runs; distinct before/after arena source versions

attention.scope: unpacked NEON matmul; one warmup and three single-call samples per shape; control/candidate differ in bounded partial loads

findings: No memcpy or other calls in matrix K loops
Complete matrix tiles and compact projection K loops have zero accumulator spills
Partial four-row matrix tiles retain four accumulator spills
Pointwise and production dense interior/border FMA loops have zero spills or calls; general dense fallback above 49 taps retains two vector spills

limits: Three fixed samples and one warmup per performance cell do not establish steady state or statistical confidence
Unbound macOS scheduling; no guaranteed performance-core placement
Final selected cases do not constitute the full 36-case platform matrix
No x86 runtime/performance validation; x86 macOS compilation only
Automatic classifiers may retain additional activation arenas; stage fairness uses snapshots

Both use nominal eight-CPU stage settings; Rust hard-caps a shared eight-worker pool across requests, while C# per-request nested budgets have no global admission cap on unbound macOS; C# has four shared CLS/REC line workers versus up to eight Rust classifiers and four Rust REC owners
Earlier diagnostic/source versions are optimization evidence and do not validate the final version

concurrent_budget_audit.rust: One shared CpuContext(8), shared by forks; fixed pool aggregate cap eight, current demand reduces each request share
concurrent_budget_audit.csharp: Each Run retains DET8, line4 and dense REC intra-op2 without global admission cap; DOTNET_PROCESSOR_COUNT=8 is not process-wide CPU enforcement
concurrent_budget_audit.interpretation: The policy difference plausibly contributes to throughput, but the measurements do not quantify its contribution separately from scheduling and kernels
